evidence.claim: Autoabode has developed the SkyShield counter-drone system utilizing a 12-layer Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on 2.1 million samples to achieve automated threat classification in under 50 milliseconds.
The company has integrated a High-Power Microwave (HPM) effector capable of a 300-meter swarm-defeat cone alongside an advanced-stage 800-meter Directed Energy Weapon (DEW) fiber laser prototype.

R&D and Innovation Capability.assessed_on: The company demonstrates advanced and actionable technology capabilities across AI classification, directed energy, and swarm mitigation, though developments remain primarily self-reported within the regional Indian defense framework without widespread international validation.

evidence.claim: According to an Autoabode Case Study, the company delivered its SkyShield counter-drone systems as part of a layered unmanned systems stack tailored entirely in India for the Indian Army.

An Autoabode Comparative Industry Review confirms that Autoabode launched its SkyShield C-UAS for national security applications in 2024 and serves defense and institutional customers, but based on primary research, the company has not disclosed market share metrics and specific quantities deployed.

Market Share & Installed Base.assessed_on: Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed their quantitative share of the Indian anti-drone market or their total installed base figures, placing the evidence in the partial, self-reported category.

evidence.claim: The company reports offering passive RF monitoring and multi-band electronic jamming through product families like the Arjuna RF Detection system, Drishti RF Detector, Gandiva RF Jammer, and Trishul I & II anti-drone guns, as outlined on the DroneVerse Counter Drone Solutions product index.

Product Portfolio Breadth (Detection, Ja.assessed_on: We verified that the company has visible capabilities in the detection and soft-kill (RF jamming) domains with multiple standalone and integrated handheld configurations. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed any proprietary hard-kill (kinetic) interception mechanisms within its counter-UAS product lineup.
